cases.prompt: Our deployed model returns a gateway timeout for chat requests, although the training run finished yesterday.
A customer gets only the first chunk from the streaming response; the rest of the answer never arrives.
Please help increase the maximum context length accepted by our existing model endpoint.
The serving process restarts every time two users request completions together.
Generated responses omit the closing JSON brace even when we request structured output.
The request queue on our inference deployment keeps growing and no completions finish.
A healthy-looking deployment accepts connections but every generation returns an empty choices array.
We added another serving replica, yet users still receive 429 errors from the chat API.
The API key is valid and our balance is positive; calls to the deployed model receive permission denied.
The same prompt started taking ten seconds to return its first token after a serving configuration change.
We can download the finished checkpoint, but loading it into the serving worker crashes the worker.
We want incoming chat traffic split evenly between two existing endpoint versions.
Inference responses truncate at 128 tokens despite the documented larger output limit.
Requests containing an image fail at the multimodal completion endpoint before generation starts.
Please fix the completion API rejecting a model ID that appears in its own catalog.
The model server stops responding when its prompt cache fills; monitoring continues to work.
Please fix a fine-tuning job that fails when parsing its JSONL training examples.
Our optimizer produces non-finite gradients on its second update.
We need to restart learning from saved optimizer state rather than beginning at step zero.
The fine-tuning scheduler has left our accepted job pending without a trainer allocation.
The reinforcement learning worker cannot combine rollout rewards into an update batch.
A training batch fails because the target sequence and attention mask have different lengths.
The trainer exits during gradient synchronization between its allocated GPUs.
Our run reaches its final update but the training worker never writes model weights to a checkpoint.
Please adjust gradient accumulation for the next epoch of this supervised fine-tuning job.
The dataset preparation stage rejects our conversations because some assistant turns have null content.
The teacher target file loads, but distillation fails while matching targets to student examples.
Our dashboard accurately shows a rising validation loss; we need help with overfitting and training data.
The inference deployment is healthy, but a separate adapter-training job runs out of GPU memory in backpropagation.
The saved optimizer state is incompatible with the resumed training process.
The training service refuses a dataset artifact before it starts the first optimization step.
Rewards differ between rollouts, but the RL trainer incorrectly receives zero for every update.
The agent finishes correctly, but its trace tree omits every tool-call span.
The evaluation job finished and saved scores; the results page displays a blank table.
Our metrics exporter stopped sending loss history while optimization continues normally.
A report link gives viewers an error even though the underlying run is visible.
Trace exports contain the wrong parent ID, so separate agent calls appear as one conversation.
The completed run points to the wrong source dataset in its artifact lineage diagram.
Response payloads include token usage but those counters are missing from saved spans.
Two model versions are incorrectly combined into a single latency chart series.
The agent handled a tool exception, yet the corresponding recorded span incorrectly says success.
A finished evaluation's saved row table will not open in the dashboard.
We need to remove customer email addresses from prompts before our trace exporter stores them.
The serving endpoint responds quickly; its monitoring panel displays stale latency samples.
The training checkpoint exists, but the experiment page's link to that artifact returns a broken URL.
Our invoice matches the contract, but the usage chart renders the wrong date range.
Successful retries create duplicate copies of the same call in our trace explorer.
The model answers correctly, but the observability integration assigns its spans to the wrong project.
Please correct the legal company name printed on our latest invoice.
The finance team needs to replace the expired card used for account payments.
We paid for additional credits yesterday, but the purchased balance has not been applied.
Please explain why our invoice charged twice for the same reserved GPU period.
We need a per-project financial breakdown of model serving and training charges for accounting.
The billed price per million tokens differs from the rate in our signed agreement.
We cancelled a training run at noon and want to dispute charges for the following hour.
Please issue a receipt for the credit purchase recorded on our bank statement.
Our accounts-payable team needs a purchase order reference added to the next bill.
The usage totals are correct, but our invoice lists the wrong tax jurisdiction.
Please move payment reminders to the finance department's new billing contact.
Our contract grants a service credit that has not appeared on this month's invoice.
The bank rejected our payment; how do we settle the outstanding account balance?
Our finance team needs a refund for an accidental duplicate credit purchase.
Please change the invoice currency to match the currency specified in our agreement.
We were charged for a reserved resource outside the contracted reservation dates.

description: Sixty-four hand-authored synthetic support tickets for a four-way routing task. Sixteen development tickets are shown to prompt authors; forty-eight held-out tickets are reserved for the gate.
